//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the MAIN content region — `.pc-layout__main` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Layout.main/1`, svelte `layout/Main.svelte`). A SHELL component migrated DOWN into @keenmate/pure-css, so the class is `pc-layout__main` (NOT `pa-main`); confirmed in dist/css/main.css (`.pc-layout__main`). It is an ELEMENT of the `pc-layout` block but ships as its own component, so the fixture `block` is `pc-layout__main` (its base class exists in CSS → axis-1 vacuous-scope guard stays quiet; it owns no `--*` modifier or `__*` sub-element of its own). SCOPE = INLINE CONTAINER. Canonical shape from snippets/layout.html: `<main class="pc-layout__main">…content…</main>` — content directly inside, NO inner wrapper class (core sets container-type: inline-size here, which is WHY nested pc-col-*-md etc. respond). Both wrappers emit exactly `<main class="pc-layout__main">{children}</main>` — fully reconcilable (no hook, no id, no conditionals). Canonical shape: packages/core/snippets/layout.html.

propsVocabulary.body: the main content — a plain slot token in this slice (real children would be page content). svelte `children`, keen `inner_block`.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the root <main class="pc-layout__main ..."> (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough; not a core modifier.

goldenConventions: Structural only — `<main class="pc-layout__main">{body}</main>`. The body slot is a plain text token so the diff checks the <main> tag + class + nesting. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pc-layout__main'). The `.pc-layout__main` class is a lone element of the pc-layout block with NO modifier of its own (no `.pc-layout__main--*`) and NO sub-element (no `.pc-layout__main__*`). So the contract is minimal: the base class + a body slot + a class passthrough. `produces: null` everywhere.

body.note: the main content; svelte `children`, keen `inner_block`. Structural — produces no class.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the root pc-layout__main main; svelte `class`, keen `class`.

deferred.//: The .pc-layout__main class owns no `--*` modifier and no `__*` sub-element in CSS — nothing to defer. (Its SIBLING pc-layout element classes — __inner/__content/__footer/__sidebar — belong to the pc-layout CONTAINER block, covered by the layout fixture, not this one; they are not matched by this fixture's ^pc-layout__main regexes.)
